answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded wharf that changes every epoch. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its island never becomes influence. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the fable behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal vpa5f.
